name: Dubai Classifieds
about: Neighbour-to-neighbour listings for useful things in Dubai. Meet safely, describe items honestly, and never pay before checking.

stories.text: Clearing a spare room this weekend; honest listings only.

posts.author: p72
posts.text: Giving away a sturdy desk in Al Barsha after a home-office move. It has scratches but no wobble; pickup only and please bring help for the stairs.

comments.author: p49
